background: Deutsche Bank is Germany's largest bank, a universal bank with a large investment bank, a corporate bank, German retail banking under the Deutsche and Postbank brands, and the DWS asset manager.
synthesis: All three main agencies rate the bank, A+ on average and the weakest of them at A, two on a positive outlook and one stable, after a two-notch upgrade by one of the three on 12 May 2026. The ratings are moving up while the ratios sit at the weak end of EU and Nordic banks: CET1 of 13.9%, leverage of 4.5% and LCR of 140% are all in the bottom quarter and NSFR of 118% is below the median, though none has moved materially over the past four periods. The flagged news is heavy, the newest on 6 Oct 2026 on credit losses ahead of its third-quarter results, alongside a client fraud involving forged contracts and a regulatory settlement.
